notablePrerequisites:
Chulane does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one creature card in hand.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3} plus enough mana to cast the creature card.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Cast the creature card by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land card onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
